newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.711 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.711 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended October 26 was 4,710,651 gallons compared with 4,077,486 gallons last week.
Imports were 3,509,994 gallons compared with 439,602 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 35,895 gallons versus 73,228 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 1,194,303 gallons compared with 1,131,017 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,295,647 gallons versus 3,820,864 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 250,050,735 versus 247,963,228 a year ago.
Inventory was 52,895,461 versus 62,050,721 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
